title: Upload Rate
description:
A tournament server must upload every replay before the next round starts in `hours` hours. `sizes` lists each replay's size in megabytes. The server uploads at a fixed rate of `r` megabytes per hour, one replay at a time, and a replay that finishes early still uses its whole last hour (so a replay of size `s` takes `ceil(s / r)` hours).

Return the smallest whole-number rate `r` that uploads everything within `hours`. You may assume `hours` is at least the number of replays.
